integrity: Original analytic comparison is the unequal-length edge-weighted law and strict shape ordering. Known area-uniform benchmark and the corresponding equal-edge-mass constant are explicitly attributed. Numerical Monte Carlo supplies corroboration, not proof.
scientific_limitations: Three independent arclength-uniform boundary samples of a nondegenerate triangle; centroid only. The numerical classic equilateral probability was established by Prekopa (1972). Earlier exact first-public calendar dates for the historical print papers are not verified. No third-party independent audit.
title: Exact arclength-boundary centroid capture and strict triangle-shape ordering
